tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fills (main button, active nav item, links on hover). Pair text with on-fill.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Brand-colored text and links on surface-page/surface-raised; hover/active state of brand fills; aliased by focus-ring.

tokens.name: brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background for the selected sidebar item and brand badges; pair with brand-strong text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Secondary action fills (outline/secondary buttons use it as border+text, not fill, on light; dark theme may fill with on-fill text).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text on surface-page/surface-raised and on accent-subtle.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background for secondary badges and callouts; pair with accent-strong text.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid brand or accent fills (e.g. primary button label).

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: App background, behind every page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the sidebar, table rows, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header band, hovered row, code/receipt paper background.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px border: inputs, panels, table rows, dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Structural dividers only (between page sections, table foot rule) - decorative, never used to signal state; state uses danger/focus-ring instead.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-page and surface-raised (14.3:1 / 15.2:1 light; 15.2:1 / 13.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, table headers, helper text, meta (5.7:1+ on surface-page).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels only - never the only carrier of required content (3.5:1+ on surface-page, below body-text floor by design).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text/icon (in-stock, paid, imported OK) on surface-page and success-subtle. Shifted blue-green, not pure green - see README color-blind note.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Success badge/row background; pair with success text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text/icon (below minimum, overdue, import row failed) on surface-page and danger-subtle.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Danger badge/row background; pair with danger text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text/icon (near reorder level, pending review) on surface-page and warning-subtle.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Warning badge/row background; pair with warning text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text/icon (draft, in progress) on surface-page and info-subtle.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Info badge/row background; pair with info text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard-focus outline on every interactive element, 2px offset. Never removed, only restyled.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a Dialog or the CommandPalette overlay, same value in both themes - dims the page without hiding what's behind it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title, in the Page header, left-aligned.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and section titles inside a page.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Table column headers, emphasized cell values, nav item labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text: field values, table cells, paragraphs.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Money, quantity and RUC columns - always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits align down a column. A converted secondary amount (US$ beside Gs, per ADR-0020) repeats this style at small/ink-faint size directly beneath, never inline.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Field labels, helper text, timestamps, table meta.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Button labels, badges, segmented-control options, sidebar section headers (uppercase, +0.02em).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its adjacent control (row-actions, toolbar buttons).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a field's label and input; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between fields in a form-grid; table cell horizontal padding; panel padding on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a page's header and its content; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked panels/sections; page side padding on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page side padding; sidebar width unit.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, table containers, sidebar items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, the command palette.
